title: Baby Feeding Interval and Daily Total
dataSources: Baby feeds (`baby:feed`), baby sleep (`baby:sleep`), diaper changes (`diaper:change`), chore completions (`chore:completion`), allowance ledger (`allowance:ledger`), family calendar (`family:calendar`), growth measurements (`growth:measurement`).
app: Baby-tracking apps (Huckleberry/Baby Daybook exports), chore and allowance boards, shared family calendars, and growth logs — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=baby:feed
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as feeds, sum(amount_ml) as ml by _time
| sort - _time
description: Adds up daily feeds and volume for a new baby so bleary-eyed parents can answer the paediatrician's questions with real numbers.
value: In the newborn fog, counting feeds and totals by memory is impossible; a clear daily record brings calm and confidence.
implementation: Log each feed to `index=personal` from your tracking app; schedule daily and review counts and totals.
visualization: Column chart of daily feeds with volume overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how often and how much the baby fed each day, so tired parents have real numbers for the doctor.
